data.title: User data concatenated into the where-condition string (SQL injection)
data.message: where condition app->where concatenates a variable directly (at /samples/php-projects/laravel/bagisto/packages/Webkul/Shop/src/Http/Controllers/DataGridController.php:37) — SQL injection risk
data.remediation: Use the parameterised form ->where('col = ?', [$var]); never write a variable into the SQL string.
